evidence.section: Requirements; Supported regions; Enable Agent Mode; Cloud Connected setup and certificate prerequisites
evidence.statement: The feature guide lists 10.1.x+, 2.1.0+ for the stated feature path, 15 specific AWS regions, runtime and enablement requirements, and CMP certificate/port prerequisites. Install and SAIA-9918 exclude Cloud Connected 2.2.0–2.3.6; 2.1.1 workaround omits Agent Mode and 2.4.0 is planned. The separate runtime guide allows third-party inference and distinguishes Global and Data zone routing. The base limited IL2 statement excludes Agent Mode and fixes runtime to hosted models.
